items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I seen him in California. We were making a date the same time as Ellington was making a date in California. I seen him keep Ellington from 8 o'clock in the morning until 6 o'clock at night without making a side.

ctx.x: Who made the records? Do you know?

Yeah. The ones they made here, you mean? Uh, uh... August Schillang on drums. Uh... Santo, Rap. Well now they made... They made two sessions here. They made an OK session here and they made a Victor session here. The OK was with Santo, Rap, Paul... Steve Loiskaner, Freddie Newman, piano, and Chink. And a tenor? Lester. Lester Bouchon. Yeah. And the drums? August Schillang. Yeah. The Victor date, it started out with the same band, but Rap, Old Man King was the recording you used. You ought to know about him…
